notes.title: 2025-01-26 Update Notes
notes.content:
1.Enhancing player experience
2.Fixing known issues
3.Conducting routine game maintenance

notes.title: 2024-10-31 Update Notes
notes.content:
1.Fixed the blurring issue in drawing within Master Mode
2.Routine game maintenance

notes.title: 2024-10-13 Update Notes
notes.content:
1. Added "Code" invite feature: Get the code from the top-right corner of match history, click to copy, and enter it in "Relay Code" on the home page to join the match.
2.Fixed the bug where the image became blurry after each save in Creative Master.
3. Fixed known issues and optimized game performance.

notes.title: 2024-07-31 Update Notes
notes.content:
1.Increased the room capacity for "realtime_mode" from 6 to 10 players.
2.Fixed the issue where some input methods were not displayed in full-screen mode.
3.Enhanced the emoji feature, now allowing emojis to be used in any mode.
4.Added QR code sharing for completed matches.

notes.title: 2024-07-12 Update Notes
notes.content:
1. "Classic mode" now includes options for selecting the number of rounds and word cards.
2. "Real-time guess" adds word card selection and dynamic emojis in chat.
3. Optimized the layout of "Classic mode".
4. Improved card pack selection mechanism: all owned packs are now set to "in use" by default, no need for manual activation.
5. Fixed the bug that prevented window resizing.

notes.title: 2024-06-20 Update Notes
notes.content:
1.New "Creative Doodle" Mode: Unleash your creativity and doodle to your heart's content.
2.New in the Store: 4 brand-new avatar frames and 4 new brushes for you to choose from.
3.Avatar Frame Upgrade: All avatar frames have been upgraded to dynamic effects, making them more lively and fun.
4.Interaction Optimization: Improved overall interactive experience with smoother operations.
5.Hint Optimization: Enhanced hint content for a more user-friendly gaming experience.
6.Fixed several bugs in “anime_mode”.

notes.title: 2024-05-29 Update Notes
notes.content:
1. Added daily missions, which can earn a large amount of gold coins.
2. Added GIF animation download feature.
3. Added line optimization option in the settings menu (enabled by default).
4. Optimized the display method of the mode list.
5. Optimized logic to reduce input delay.
6. Fixed an issue where some brushes could not be used.

notes.title: 2024-03-22 Update Notes
notes.content:
1. Fixed known bugs.
2. Enhanced user experience.

notes.title: 2024-03-07 Update Notes
notes.content:
1.Fixed the issue where the trial version features were not unlocked when transitioning to the full version. Now you can smoothly enjoy all the features of the official version.
2.Optimized the replay interface of each mode, expanding the artwork display area, allowing you to better appreciate and review your artwork.
3.Enhanced the "Replay" functionality. You can now replay and fast-forward by simply clicking on the artwork, eliminating the need for cumbersome buttons and making the operation more intuitive.
4.Made improvements to the real-time competition question interface, providing a more comfortable and seamless experience during the answering process, allowing you to focus on unleashing your creativity and solving the questions.
5.Enhanced the effect display while drawing in "Story Chain" mode, making your artwork more vivid and rich.
6.Improved the presentation of the color palette, making it easier for you to select and use various colors.
7.Made meticulous adjustments to the display effects across various interfaces, enhancing the overall user experience and aesthetics of the game.

notes.title: 2024-02-21 Update Notes
notes.content:
1、Fixed the issue where typing in "Story mode" would trigger shortcut keys.
2、Fixed the problem where some devices were unable to draw properly.

notes.title: 20240220 Update Notes
notes.content:
1、Improved interaction by adding a secondary confirmation dialog when submitting.
2、Optimized the replay display of "Animation mode", now only showing one instance when the same player appears consecutively.
3、Fixed a bug that caused crashes when undoing actions.
4、Fixed the issue of abnormal positioning for bullet screen messages.

notes.title: 2024-02-08: Update Description
notes.content:
1.Optimize the sharing link.
2.Enhance the touchpad experience.
3.Improve the network connection for Real-time guess.

notes.title: January 30th update instructions
notes.content:
1.Added "Animation mode" gameplay, come and make them move!
2.Added "Download" feature, you can now download using the download icon next to the artwork.
3.Introduced "Auto Save Image" feature, which can be enabled in the "Settings". When enabled, it will automatically save the artwork locally upon submission.
4.Added "Auto Refresh" feature for "Real-time Quiz".
5.Add 5 word card packs
6.Fixed the issue of loading exceptions for more than 20 items in the list.
7.Fixed the problem of "Workshop" creation failure.
8.Optimized brush size, allowing adjustment to smaller or larger sizes.
9.Optimized the toolbar, allowing individual customization of the size for each tool.
10.Enhanced the painting experience in "Real-time Mode" by reducing the range of bullet screen appearance.
11.Improved dynamic effect of the progress bar.
12.Optimized the layout of "Bulletin".
13.Optimized the layout of "Story mode".
14.Optimized the layout of "Drawing master".
15.Optimized the layout of "Moments".
16.Optimized the guessing interface.
17.Optimized the creation interface.
18.Optimized the performance when unable to connect to the server during login, added manual server switching.
